verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing commerce product catalog, so agent checkout is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence only shows product search and lookup (its UCP support is scoped to search and lookup) and affiliate buy URLs that track sales. MPP covers paying for Channel3's own API usage, not completing merchant purchases, so it is an adjacent feature. Nothing documents a checkout session, a delegated payment credential, or order confirmation.
